Evangelist Accused of Child Sexual Abuse in Andhra Pradesh Orphanage

The National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) has been urged to investigate an orphanage in Andhra Pradesh following the arrest of evangelist Abraham Jaipaul Papabathini by the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) in the United States. Papabathini, 53, is accused of sexual offenses against minors in India. The Legal Rights Protection Forum (LRPF) filed a complaint with the NHRC seeking intervention in the matter.
